description: Find a person's LinkedIn profile URL from their name and company domain or company name, read from Google result pages through the Apify Google SERP proxy; LinkedIn itself is never opened. Returns one row per person with linkedin_url, match_status (found at a confidence of 0.8 or more with a clear lead over any other profile, ambiguous with the likely URL, not_found, or blocked), match_confidence from 0 to 1, name_match, company_match (current, former, mentioned, none), the headline, snippet, and follower count Google shows, and the runner up. Batch up to 500 persons in persons. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN; Apify charges one event per person searched (found, ambiguous, or not found); blocked and error rows are free.

allow_name_only.description: true searches a person with no company; such a row is never found, only ambiguous. Default false.

company_domain.description: The company domain, for example hashicorp.com. Give this or company_name.

company_name.description: Optional. The company name as people write it, used instead of the word in the domain.

country.description: Two letter Google country code. Default us.

full_name.description: The person's first and last name, for example Armon Dadgar.

job_title.description: Optional. A headline that agrees gets a small boost.

keywords.description: Optional extra words for the Google query.

location.description: Optional city or country. A small boost when the snippet agrees.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount.

persons.description: Several persons, one per line as Full Name | company.com | job title. Up to 500.

name: resolve_person_linkedin_url
title: Resolve a person's LinkedIn URL
